item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President presently assigns departments and agencies an internal continuity-of-government duty; the segment does not itself alter external legal rights or dictate a later legal outcome.","evidence":"The departments and agencies of the Federal Government are hereby severally charged with the duty of assuring the continuity of the Federal Government"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"Departments, agency heads, and the OEP Director must plan, prepare, coordinate, and maintain readiness; implementation of those plans expressly requires separate future legal authority.","evidence":"shall develop such plans and take such actions"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of State must prepare internal emergency plans and preparedness programs for possible future conditions, without imposing a specified legal consequence.","evidence":"shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of State must direct, coordinate, and supervise other agencies' emergency-preparedness work, an internal executive-management assignment.","evidence":"shall provide to all other departments and agencies overall foreign policy direction, coordination, and supervision"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of State must develop policies, plans, and procedures for future emergency foreign-relations functions; the segment assigns broad administrative responsibility without presently producing or dictating a specific legal result.","evidence":"shall develop policies, plans, and procedures for carrying out his responsibilities"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Treasury Secretary must develop emergency policies, plans, procedures, and coordination arrangements; no particular loan, regulation, payment, or other legally consequential outcome is mandated.","evidence":"shall develop policies, plans and procedures for the performance of emergency functions"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The Defense Secretary receives broad planning, guidance, assistance, administration, and preparedness duties, but the segment neither presently changes legal rights nor mandates a specified later legal outcome.","evidence":"the Secretary of Defense shall perform the following emergency preparedness functions"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The Attorney General must advise, review, coordinate, and develop emergency plans and procedures; contemplated detention, seizure, and other measures are subjects of planning rather than legal consequences imposed by this segment.","evidence":"Develop emergency plans for the control of alien enemies and other aliens within the United States"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The Postmaster General must prepare plans and programs for future emergency mail service, which is an internal preparedness function.","evidence":"shall prepare plans and programs for emergency mail service"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The Postmaster General must cooperate with agencies on planning and administering emergency programs; the segment does not itself impose censorship, registration, or another legal consequence.","evidence":"shall cooperate with indicated Federal agencies"},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"The Interior Secretary must prepare plans, programs, guidance, and interagency assistance concerning emergency resources; the definitions and planning assignments do not themselves alter legal rights.","evidence":"shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs"},{"segment_id":"12","code":1,"rationale":"The Federal Power Commission must assist the Interior Secretary with preparedness planning, an internal interagency-support assignment.","evidence":"the Federal Power Commission shall assist the Secretary of the Interior"},{"segment_id":"13","code":1,"rationale":"The Agriculture Secretary must prepare plans and preparedness programs and administer inventories to assure emergency availability, without a specified allocation or other binding legal outcome.","evidence":"shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs"},{"segment_id":"14","code":1,"rationale":"The Agriculture Secretary must develop plans, direct preparedness activities, and furnish guidance concerning lands and civil defense; these are internal planning and implementation assignments rather than specified legal consequences.","evidence":"develop plans for a national program, direct Federal activities, and furnish technical guidance"}]}
